items.title: Airbnb Stock Rallies On Earnings Beat. AI Paying Off, Says CEO.
items.summary: Airbnb stock leaped Friday after the online vacation rental platform posted second-quarter results ahead of estimates and offered a strong forecast for the September quarter.  Airbnb said late Thursday that it earned $1.37 per share for the June-ended quarter, up 33% from a year earlier.  Sales increased 17% to $3.61 billion, compared with analyst estimates of $3.58 billion.
